title: Console Connectivity Playbook: Multi-Cluster Network Insights & Upgrade Impact Microviews
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact, task-driven "playbook" surface within the Private Console that surfaces multi-cluster connectivity insights and simulates upgrade impact at a per-tenant level. Goals: (1) Help operators quickly triage cross-VPC link failures and identify which tenants or routes are affected; (2) Provide a lightweight upgrade impact microview that predicts latency and egress cost delta for planned private cluster upgrades; (3) Offer recommended remediation steps (network-level and rollout-level) and one-click links to runbook artifacts or start a canary rollout. Constraints: must fit into existing console nav as a secondary panel, respect RBAC for private deployments, and avoid exposing raw infra logs in the summary view. Accessibility: color contrast for status badges, keyboard focus for microview controls, and screen-reader friendly summaries. Success metrics: reduce mean time-to-detect network incidents for Private clusters by 30% in first quarter post-launch, increase rollback rate for risky upgrades by 15% (faster rollbacks via playbook links), and achieve a SUS score >= 75 in operator usability tests.
comments: 2025-11-03 - Initial brief: PM (Aria Patel) requested a single-pane playbook combining connectivity traces, recent route changes, and upgrade simulation. Scope trimmed to 'insights + microview' to keep MVP within cycle.

2025-11-05 - Design exploration: created three low-fi flows (timeline-first, heatmap-first, and checklist-first). Team favoured timeline-first for incident context but wanted a compact heatmap for quick at-a-glance status.

2025-11-06 - Technical sync with ENG (lead: Javier Morales): discussed feasibility of showing 1-hour KV cache hit rate alongside network latency. Javier flagged potential perf cost to fetch live KV metrics for large tenants; suggested precomputed aggregates in observability pipeline.

2025-11-07 - Prototype: Figma link https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/console-connectivity-playbook (private) and interactive prototype attached. Prototype includes: cluster map, route health mini-heatmap, recent topology changes, upgrade-impact slider (simulates config/quantization changes), and remediation checklist with runbook links.

2025-11-08 - Design review notes from PM (Aria Patel): emphasize 'one-click mitigation' flows (rollout canary, scale-out, throttle egress) and ensure explicit confirmations for actions affecting tenant traffic.

2025-11-09 - Usability testing plan drafted (moderated sessions with 6 infra engineers). Key tasks: triage a cross-region egress spike, preview upgrade impact for a 10% latency-sensitive tenant, initiate a canary rollout. Metrics: task completion time, error rate, and confidence rating.

2025-11-10 - Security review prep: added data-scope guardrails. Sensitive network identifiers will be redacted for non-privileged roles. Security flagged audit-log link for all 'one-click' actions; added to acceptance criteria.

2025-11-10 - Engineering follow-up (PR draft): GitHub PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/2548 created by ENG to add API surface for 'connectivity-insights' with aggregated metrics endpoint.

2025-11-10 - Next steps: finalize hi-fi mocks, iterate accessibility fixes, run first moderated usability sessions 2025-11-12, and produce handoff packet for eng with acceptance criteria and data contract.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook shows aggregated route health for selected private clusters
Upgrade impact microview simulates latency and egress cost deltas for at least three configurable knobs (instance size, quantization level, and batch size)
One-click remediation actions open a guarded modal and create an audit log entry
UI adheres to RBAC: non-admins see redacted identifiers and a read-only view
design_notes: Prefer timeline-first main column with collapsible heatmap sidebar for compactness
Use 3-tier severity badges (OK / Degraded / Critical) mapped to existing console palette
Expose a small 'why this matters' tooltip explaining cost delta calculations (to avoid operator confusion)
Fallback when metrics are delayed: show last-known snapshot and a freshness timestamp
user_testing_plan: Recruit 6 infra/platform engineers across SMB and enterprise customers
Task 1: Identify affected tenants from a simulated route disruption
Task 2: Use upgrade-impact slider to estimate latency change for a target tenant
Collect SUS and task completion times; debrief for qualitative feedback
